1445-1913-4871-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You have a creature card in hand and an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1913-4871-7272.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers if the creature that was returned to your hand was an artifact, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4478-5078-6766-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7234-8095.easyPrerequisites: There are a total of at least X cards in all hands.
6972-7234-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Realm Seekers.
When Realm Seekers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1766-1999-4613-7340.easyPrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1766-1999-4613-7340.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding at least two mana which you can spend to activate Master Transmuter due to Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Thran Dynamo from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sewer-veillance Cam from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thran Dynamo from your hand onto the vattlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it

1636-3143-7426.description:
Activate Berta by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Fractal enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Fractal, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2021-2060-2445-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
2021-2060-2445-7803.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

3996-4050-7824.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Spirits, adding {2}{W}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat.

670-1619-3742-6141.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6141.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Displacer Beast until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Displacer Beast to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Displacer Beast enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Beast trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Displacer Beast until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

955-2033-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
955-2033-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
955-2033-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2185-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2185-2921-6972.notes: If Howlgeist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1170-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7415.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Old-Growth Educator.
When Old-Growth Educator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Old-Growth Educator enters, it triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

240-3967-4742-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Patron of the Arts

1409-1652-4772.description:
Activate Patron of the Arts by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Patron of the Arts enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Patron of the Arts.
Resolve the Patron of the Arts trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

4890-5282-7149.description:
Cast Dack's Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Dack's Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Dack's Duplicate dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Dack's Duplicate enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Dack's Duplicate leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Dack's Duplicate from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-3755-4359-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3755-4359-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2173-2921-4336-5220.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3755-5051-5078-5243.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

4798-5437-6462.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4798-5437-6462.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers. Holding priority, activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 2.

1349-2921-6012.notablePrerequisites:
There is a coin counter on any creature you control except Athreos.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature if Reluctant Role Model is the only creature you control with a coin counter on it.
1349-2921-6012.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Reluctant Role Model's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter on it if it wasn't the creature that was sacrificed, or another nontoken creature you control otherwise.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1722-2034-2425.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1722-2034-2425.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
Smothering Abomination's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.

1734-2150-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes to the battlefield from exile.
When Hero of the Dunes enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Fiend Hunter's power.
Repeat.

365-575-3510.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Saproling and/or creature with changeling.
365-575-3510.description:
Activate Elvish Farmer's second ability by sacrificing a nontoken Saproling or creature with changeling.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 Saproling due to Life and Limb.
Resolve the Elvish Farmer ability, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1110-1605-3059.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

628-4924-4929.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat step 1 until Cryptic Trilobite does not have any +1/+1 counters on it.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Cryptic Trilobite's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1365-2198-2511-2527-5294.easyPrerequisites:
Vohar does not have summoning sickness.
Deceiver Exarch does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1365-2198-2511-2527-5294.description:
Activate Vohar's first ability by tapping it.
Vohar triggers, giving creatures you control that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Vohar ability from step 1, causing you to loot.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 4, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Deceiver Exarch persist until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Vohar.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 9, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2146-3532-4928-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2146-3532-4928-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2232-3667-4050.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to white is at least four.
2232-3667-4050.description:
Cast Evangel of Heliod by paying {4}{W}{W}.
When Evangel of Heliod enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Evangel of Heliod trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to your devotion to white.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Evangel of Heliod to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six Soldiers, adding {4}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
If your devotion to white excluding Evangel of Heliod is at least five, this combo will net infinite colored mana.

2972-4694-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
"Dragon" chosen with Conspiracy.
2972-4694-4875.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a Dragon due to Conspiracy.
Ganax triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 0/0 Dragon due to March of the Machines and Conspiracy.
The Treasure dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

746-1069-1778-4763.notablePrerequisites:
Mask of Immolation attached to Memnite.
You control at least three artifacts.
746-1069-1778-4763.description:
Activate Memnite by sacrificing it.
Memnite dies, triggering Koll, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Memnite ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Activate Mask of Immolation's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Memnite.
Repeat.

3742-4050-4681.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phantom Steed, adding one mana of any color.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, exiling Karmic Guide until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Repeat.

132-1978-2364.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Mana Vault's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
If Voltaic Construct is on the battlefield, activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder. Otherwise, activate Myr Welder using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.
